page.layout: One printed page, single text column; running head at top centre; page number top right; catchword/signature at foot left of the column ("Ff" centre, "quiescen-" right as catchword).

main_text.l: Henrici à Blodorff/ Joannis à Reuscheinberg in Luppenaw/N. ab
Hocun/N. ab Hartt in Loerszberg/ Wolfgangi Caspari Adelman/
V Wolfgangi Theodoriab Hoeten/Theodori à Diepenbruch/Wil-
helmi à Nesselraedt/Ioannis à Niewkirchen/Reinheri Solinandri
& Ioannis Lithodii Doctorum Medicorum: V Vinandi Thomasii
aulici concionatoris, Iacobi Kremer & Ioannis Kieff culinæ gra-
phiariorum cum reliquis ad tam splendidam aulam necessariis mi-
nistris. Sponsam vero Ducalem comitatæ, Margaretha ex fami-
lia Marcana Arenbergæ & Barbansonii, Amœna à Dhaun, Falc-
kensteinii, Gumperti Novariensis & Alpensis vidua, Comites ; vi-
dua Hallensis aulæ præfecta Christina & Arnholda à
Wachtendonck/Anna ab Hurdt/ Maria Bilandica, cum nobilissimis Buire-
na,Elleria, & Schureria virginibus aulicis. Ultima Augusti Siege-
berga solvens,equitatum per Ten(Hundsruggen) ductori-
bus ei per Johannem à Reuschenberg/ Dominum in Setterich au-
læ Marescalcum, Volmaro à Scheidt dicto Wesspenning/ præfecto Blanckenbergio, & Joanne Buxr constitutis VWeissenkir-
cha Andernacum pergentes ibidem ab Hermanno Manderschei-
diæ & Blanckenheimiæ Comite, Georgio à Lep Magistro aulæ
provinciali V Vilhelmo ab Hoist in Heimertzen hæreditario, &
Joanne Kurtzrock/ Licentiato nomine Archiepiscopi Colonien-
sis : Treviri vero a Friderico à Reiffenberg Galliæ Chiliarcha,
Joanne Zandten à Merle/ & Conrado à Ret/licentiato verbis &
muneribus excepti 1 Septembris confluentiam appulere, ubi ab
ipso Electore Treviro in ripa salutati inque arcem Ehrenbretsteiniam
ducti Ernestum Hennebergium cum uxore V Veitenbergia,
Joannis Nassovii conjuge & Comite Reitterscheidia ex balneo
sylvestri reduces, obvios habuerunt. 2 Septembris navigium cum
Philippo Nassovio rursus ingressi, S. Goarini à Landgravii Philip-
pi Cancellario D. Nordeccio accepti, & Bacharacchum 3 Se-
ptembris prætervecti, Carolo Arnsbergio comitante Bingium a-
spexere, ubi, cum Reichardus Palatinus per Cancellarium & no-
bilissimum Geispitzium, quod ipsus ob crurifragium non venisset,
le excusasset, 4 Septembris Moguntiam devenere; sed prius à Ma-
rescbalco Bickenio, vice Domino Brendelio & Doctore Philippo
contecto navigio in Rheno præventi,inque castrum Martinianum
deducti, ex eo ab Alberto Packio Burggravio Alzeano conducti
sunt. 6 Septembris igitur Moguntiâ Openheimium progressi à
Philippo VVamboldo ab Umbstadt/ ad novam arcem invitati,
ubi 7 Septembr. Gernsheimii in arce Moguntinâ pernoctassent, 8
VVormatiam devenerunt: quâ in urbe præfectus Germershei-
mius Christophorus à Gotfarth nomine Electoris Palatini, &
Ioannes Falckensteinii comes cum sorore Amœna vidua Nova-
quilana comparuere: Inde undecima Septembris, ad Norcum ar-
cem exque ea Spiram 12 appulere, à Marquardo ab Hatstein Epi-
scopo excepti. 13 post peracta sacræ Reinhusium, 14 Mulbrun-
num,15 Stutgardiam sedem Ducis Wirtembergensis,& 16 ibidem
quiescen-

page.notes: Black-letter names are rendered in bl tags; several proper names and the Greek-free text are doubtful, notably "Hoist", "Hartt", "Kieff", "Hatstein" and "Tenderos"; the line "Tenteros(Hundsruggen)" is partly illegible. The line "excepti" contains a stray character and may be a misprint.
